description: This Java source file defines an Android activity, 'LNotificationActivity', which provides a tabbed interface to display different fragments related to notification samples, such as Heads Up notifications, visibility metadata, and other types.

classes.name: LNotificationActivity
classes.description: An activity that hosts a tabbed interface for viewing different notification sample fragments.

classes.name: NotificationsPagerAdapter
classes.description: A FragmentPagerAdapter that manages three fragments, each representing a different notification sample.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and sets up the ViewPager with its adapter and tabs.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the fragment associated with each tab position; creates new instances of fragments for each tab.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of tabs (3).

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Provides the title for each tab based on its position.

methods.name: NotificationsPagerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor for the adapter, receives a FragmentManager to manage fragments.
